before.method: Actual solo engine; faction-specific 2400/7200 CR budgets, mirrored sides, waves 20/60, natural hero consolidation, 90s limit. Timeouts are not wins. Fixed formations are diagnostic, not player win rates.

after.method: Actual solo engine; faction-specific 2400/7200 CR budgets, mirrored sides, waves 20/60, natural hero consolidation, 90s limit. Timeouts are not wins. Fixed formations are diagnostic, not player win rates.

summary.method: real game-v2.js and tri-lane-engine.js with true CR purchases, configured wave/factory timers, normal/hard AI and standard/augment; max 144 solo or 136 multi waves

limits: Fixed budget engagements are not player win rates.
Timeouts in the pricing harness include remaining-value evaluation; the role harness never counts a timeout as a win.
Four-seed, one-of-each faction skirmishes diagnose a fixed formation; they do not establish full-match faction parity.
Prism combinations are covered by functional regression tests, not an exhaustive search over all augment combinations.
